scope: First-layer q_proj plus first-layer KV numerical reference. Full-sequence metrics use simulated decode precision, not native prefill; cache smoke test uses BF16 prefill; no fused CUDA, no MMA layout, no latency or whole-model compression claim. Cache mirror is regenerated for each reference attention call; BF16 primary is retained. FP8 delayed emission is tensor-tested only.
